title: Flyn | The #1 Bitly Alternative for Modern Teams
excerpt: Create branded short links, track clicks, and generate QR codes. The modern Bitly alternative built for growth teams. Free plan available.

How it works

Get started in under 60 seconds. No credit card required.

Step 01

Paste your URL

Drop any long URL into the shortener. Flyn auto-detects the title, favicon, and Open Graph metadata so your link looks great when shared.

Step 02

Customize everything

Pick a custom slug, connect your branded domain, add UTM tags, set up geo routing, or protect with a password. Make it yours.

Step 03

Share & track

Share your short link anywhere. Watch clicks roll in with real-time analytics, device, location, referrer, and more. All from one dashboard.

Use Cases

From solo creators to enterprise teams, Flyn adapts to how you work.

Marketing Teams

Track every campaign link. See which channels drive clicks, conversions, and revenue, all in one dashboard.

Developers

RESTful API, TypeScript SDK, webhooks. Automate link creation in your CI/CD pipeline or app.

E-Commerce

Branded links for every product. Track which social post or email drove that sale with click analytics and geo breakdowns.

Healthcare

GDPR-compliant links with password protection and auto-expiry. Share patient resources securely.

Agencies

Manage multiple branded domains for multiple clients. One dashboard, unlimited possibilities.

Education

Dynamic QR codes on handouts and slides. Update the destination anytime without reprinting.
